crossRefs.note: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls on the ground apart from your Father’s will,
Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more…
Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his…
For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.
Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

translations.web: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.
translations.bsb: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.
translations.kjv: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
translations.asv: Are not five sparrows sold for two pence? and not one of them is forgotten in the sight of God.
